description: This file declares the interface for the COM module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform. It includes function prototypes for sending and receiving signals, handling dynamic signals, triggering transmissions, and managing signal groups.

methods.name: Com_SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal identified by SignalId with the data pointed to by SignalDataPtr.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveSignal
methods.description: Receives a signal identified by SignalId into the buffer pointed to by SignalDataPtr.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveDynSignal
methods.description: Receives a dynamic signal with specified length into SignalDataPtr, outputs length via Length.

methods.name: Com_SendDynSignal
methods.description: Sends a dynamic signal with specified length from SignalDataPtr.

methods.name: Com_TriggerTransmit
methods.description: Triggers transmission of a PDU with the given ID, filling PduInfoPtr.

methods.name: Com_TriggerIPduSend
methods.description: Triggers the sending of an IPDU with the specified ID.

methods.name: Com_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates that a PDU has been received.

methods.name: Com_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms the transmission of a PDU.

methods.name: Com_SendSignalGroup
methods.description: Sends a signal group specified by SignalGroupId.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveSignalGroup
methods.description: Receives a signal group into the buffer for SignalGroupId.

methods.name: Com_UpdateShadowSignal
methods.description: Updates the shadow copy of a signal.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveShadowSignal
methods.description: Receives data into the shadow copy of a signal.
